lines: Sunday night and Monday is coming
The Sage wants to understand the week first.
The Warrior just wants to get going.
caption:
Two ways to face a Monday.

The Sage wants to understand before acting. The Warrior gets stronger from resistance and would rather just start. Neither is wrong. They just burn out in different ways.

Sage or Warrior on a Sunday night?

Comment ARCHETYPE and I'll send you the test 📩
